## /rebar-debug FINAL REPORT — landed & closed

**Landed:** Gerrit change 2353 (PS3) `3481da26e491` — LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1, submitted to
`origin/main`. Ticket `sugarcane-scrummy-arctichare` (29c3-b025-04d7-454e) closed
`--class=plan_defect --caused-by=c799-3a71-3bcd-433e`.

- **Problem** — `rebar fsck --output json` reported an `issue_count` that disagreed with the
  process exit code on the same store, and an uninitialised store rendered in JSON
  byte-identically to a clean one.

- **Proven root cause** — the count was computed in two independent places. The exit code comes
  from `_scan`'s `is_issue`-respecting tally (`_commands/fsck_tracker_health.py`
  `issues += int(is_issue)` → `_commands/fsck.py` `rc = 0 if issue_count == 0 else 1`), while
  `_transform_json` (`_commands/fsck.py`) recomputed `issue_count = len(issues)` over EVERY
  emitted uppercase `KIND:` line with no knowledge of `is_issue`. The never-counted kinds
  (`push_pending`, `status_fork_resolved`, `tracker_dirty_tmp_event`, `warn`) thus inflated the
  JSON count but not the exit code. Separately, `_missing_tracker_result` emitted
  `{issues:[],fixed:[],issue_count:0}` for an uninitialised store — identical to a clean one.

- **Proof** — the held-out tests were confirmed legitimately RED against the pre-fix tree, then
  GREEN after. Mutation checks proved teeth: reverting the three `len(issues)`→counted edits
  returned the core assertions to RED (7), and dropping `.lower()` from the derived dirty set
  returned the case-fold seam + drift guards to RED (5). The prior divergence was itself
  test-pinned (`test_unsigned_env_fsck_heldout.py`, `test_doctor_dirty_tree.py`), confirming the
  behaviour was contractual, not incidental.

- **Defect origin** — introduced by commit `56e130ff7132` "feat(tier-e): port fsck in-process
  (E4)", ticket **scaly-bleat-haul** (`c799-3a71-3bcd-433e`): the in-process port shipped the
  `len(issues)` JSON count decoupled from the counted tally as its plan (no prior working
  behaviour to regress → `plan_defect`). The `caused_by` link is recorded on the ticket.

- **Test** — `tests/interfaces/facades/test_fsck_issue_count_29c3.py` (NEW, 16 tests): per-kind
  `counted` flag, counted-subset == exit-code agreement on a mixed real store, uninitialised
  distinguishable from clean, `fsck_report()` fails closed (now asserting the surfaced
  `not_initialized` detail), the dir-mismatch WARN carried alongside the counted finding, plus
  G6 drift guards (single-sourced-from-`_DIRTY_LINE_SPECS`, case-fold seam, union decomposition,
  counted-tally == exit-code-tally).

- **Fix** — redefined `issue_count` = the COUNTED subset (respecting `is_issue`) across all three
  surfaces (CLI `_transform_json`, library `_fsck_scan_report`, MCP `FsckOut`), so it AGREES with
  the exit code — the root cause, not the symptom. `issues[]` stays the complete findings list;
  each item gains an additive `counted` boolean (old total = `len(issues)`). The never-counted
  set is drift-proofed: the tracker-dirty portion is derived (lowercased) from
  `_DIRTY_LINE_SPECS`; the three inline scan/health kinds are an explicit set with pointer
  comments at each production site. Uninitialised stores now emit a counted `not_initialized`
  finding (distinct from clean) and carry the tracker.dir-mismatch WARN when present; the library
  facade fails closed on that signal. Schema adds the additive `counted`; `issue_count` stays
  integer/required. BEHAVIOR CORRECTION / BREAKING recorded in `docs/release-notes.md` and
  `CHANGELOG.md`; `docs/user-guide.md` wording made true of both surfaces.

- **Scope & safety** — caller sweep: no external or CI consumer reads `issue_count` (only rebar's
  own tests); the change aligns code with the docs. No new dependency. No existing test weakened:
  `test_fsck_structured_326f.py` updated from the `len(issues)` pin to counted semantics;
  `test_fsck_ensures.py` already encoded the counted meaning and stayed green;
  `test_repair_pause_ownership_heldout.py` got the additive `counted: true` on its pinned payload.
  `make lint` + `make typecheck` green; CI Verified +1.

- **Siblings** — the sibling sweep found a single JSON `issue_count` producer (`_transform_json`);
  the library and MCP surfaces delegate to it rather than recomputing, so there was no other
  divergent producer to fix. The three-surface edit is the full construct set.

- **Residual risk & prevention** — the explicit `_NEVER_COUNTED_SCAN_KINDS` literal (the three
  inline scan/health kinds) remains hand-maintained. **Disposition: accepted** — it is guarded by
  per-kind tests, pointer comments at each production site, and a union drift-guard; a new
  untested inline `is_issue=False` kind defaults to `counted=true` (the integrity-safe direction,
  never silently under-counting). The PS3 LLM advisories re-flagged this same seam plus two
  test-thoroughness notes; all are non-blocking and re-litigate a design already reviewed and
  accepted at the plan-review G6 gate — **accepted**, no new defect.

- **Replication** — the original report no longer reproduces: `test_cli_json_issue_count_agrees_
  with_exit_code` (real store) and `test_uninitialised_store_json_is_distinguishable_from_clean`
  pass, and CI Verified +1 on the merged commit `3481da26e491`.
